name: Hair Nest
description: A landscape of glossy chestnut waves with a hollow at its heart.
lighting: Large soft top light, one shine band along every wave
subject: either
prompt: An endless sea of glossy chestnut hair fills the frame edge to edge, laid in loose, heavy S-waves that roll away in soft diagonals, every strand running unbroken from one wave into the next. One large soft light from above draws a single bright ribbon of shine along the crest of each wave, and the troughs fall into deep warm brown. Near the centre the waves part into a shallow hollow, as if something could rest there with strands passing over and under it. There is no face, no scalp and no parting, only hair as a landscape. The palette is chestnut, copper and warm umber, glossy and sensual.
